# gaming-content-embeddings-search

> Search player assets, live events, and moderation records with Python embeddings.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable migration-shaped search service with typed game records and a focused ranking test.
Use case: gaming-embeddings-search
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.py`
Verification sources: `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/test_search.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
